name: Complete pc-Minimal Obstructions to Dismantlable Ampleness
statement: A finite partial cube is dismantlable ample exactly when it has no pc-minor isomorphic to an antipodally punctured cube $Q_n^{--}$, $n\ge3$, and no pc-minor whose Yang complex is a color-minimal nonshellable constructible ball. The punctured cubes are exactly the nonample pc-minimal obstructions; the color-minimal Yang balls are exactly the ample pc-minimal obstructions.
proof: Every nonample partial cube contains an antipodally punctured cube as a pc-minor; pc-minimality therefore makes these and only these the nonample basis layer. For an ample family, dismantlable ampleness is equivalently linear quotients of the Alexander-dual ideal, shellability of the Yang ball, or existence of an acyclic trace-carrier scheme. The two restrictions and one contraction in each coordinate are exactly the elementary pc-minors. Thus an ample failure is pc-minimal precisely when it has no acyclic trace-carrier scheme but all $3d$ elementary images do. Pc-minor closure reduces every proper minor to one of those images.
comments: The ample layer has exact finite algebraic, shellability, and trace-carrier recognition in each fixed coordinate dimension. These criteria do not yet give the stronger intrinsic generative construction sought in the manuscript. Hall's class is a named member of this general family.
